project_description: Add optional GeoIP-based HTTP ingress access control for Go-LIP. Enforce country and IP/CIDR allow/deny policy before general tracing, metrics, access logging, authentication, frontend decoding, routing, database work, or model execution; preserve exact Apache-style deny_allow / allow_deny semantics; support IPv4/IPv6 overrides and trusted reverse-proxy client-IP resolution; use a local MaxMind-compatible MMDB lookup service with safe last-known-good automatic updates; make pure policy reloadable through immutable request-plane generations while keeping MMDB/updater lifecycle process-owned. Track implementation under GitHub issue #387.
